subject: world_language
concept: Expressing a simple opinion (I think, in my opinion) in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR A2 'express simple opinions' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student states a simple opinion about a low-stakes topic using the target-language opinion phrase
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an opinion phrase to a picture showing agreement or disagreement
exercise.abstract: Student writes a sentence expressing an opinion about a described topic

misconception_flags: states a fact rather than a genuine opinion when using the opinion phrase

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
